subServices.name: Cloud Migration
subServices.desc: Move your systems to the cloud securely
subServices.longDesc: Lift, refactor, or rebuild — depending on what your workload actually needs. We migrate production systems with a zero-downtime cutover plan, a parallel run, and a clean rollback path if anything goes sideways.

subServices.name: CI/CD Pipelines
subServices.longDesc: We build pipelines that catch the bug, not the developer. Type-check, lint, test, scan, sign, and deploy on every commit — with progressive rollouts, automatic rollback on regressions, and a one-click revert when things go wrong.
bullets: GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, and Buildkite

subServices.name: Server Management
subServices.longDesc: Managed Kubernetes, serverless on AWS Lambda, or a humble VPS — we run the boring but critical parts so you can focus on the product. Patching, scaling, backups, and a 24/7 on-call rotation when something goes wrong.

subServices.name: Security Audits
subServices.longDesc: We do not sell scary reports — we sell fixed CVEs. Our security audits end with a prioritized remediation plan, a tracked set of pull requests, and a re-test. We work with SOC 2, ISO 27001, and the UAE PDPL.
bullets: Web, API, and cloud config audits
Pen testing with a real report
UAE PDPL and data residency review

faq.question: Which cloud do you recommend?
faq.answer: It depends on your existing commitments, regulatory requirements, and team. We are agnostic across AWS, GCP, Azure, and Cloudflare. We will recommend the right one for your workload after a short architecture review.

faq.question: Can you take over an existing cloud setup?
faq.answer: Yes. We start with a paid audit — architecture, cost, security, and reliability scorecard — then propose a phased plan. We have rescued accounts with surprise bills, manual deploys, and a single point of failure or two.

faq.question: Do you offer 24/7 on-call?
faq.answer: We do. We pair with your team during business hours and own a real on-call rotation outside it. Response times are documented up front, and we run a quarterly chaos test to keep the runbooks honest.

faq.question: How do you handle data residency in the UAE?
faq.answer: All major providers now have UAE regions, and we design for residency from the first diagram. We have shipped UAE-only deployments for healthcare, education, and government clients and can walk you through the trade-offs.
